t: You're looking at 6 Burlington Gardens, a Grade II* listed building in Mayfair. It was built for the University of London, and it has had several occupants since. The Civil Service Commission and the British Museum have both used it. Today it belongs to the Royal Academy of Arts. It was designed by James Pennethorne, a nineteenth-century architect and planner who is particularly associated with buildings and parks in central London. So this is one of his designs, and it has outlasted the institution it was first made for.
